title: UNDP Human Development Report
definition: The Human Development Report (HDR) is an annual flagship publication commissioned by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) that pioneers a people-centric approach to advancing human well-being, moving beyond mere GDP growth.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is a cornerstone for UPSC CSE Prelims (direct facts on HDI indicators, dimensions, and rankings) and Mains GS Paper III (Inclusive Growth, Poverty, Employment, Human Resource Development) and GS Paper II (International Organizations, Social Justice).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of UNDP Human Development Report.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Economic Growth vs. Economic Development
